product.description: Monoprice™DisplayPort® 1.4 Cable to 8K HDMI® - 10 FeetNext Generation Technology Delivers 8K@60Hz Performance, Up To 32.4Gbps BandwidthThe Monoprice DisplayPort 1.4 to 8K HDMI Cable, 8K 60Hz, 30AWG, 10ft is an essential accessory for seamlessly connecting your HDMI video display to a DisplayPort source. Whether you want to connect your video game console, Apple TV, or laptop computer to a high‑resolution display, this cable is designed to meet your needs.Engineered to comply with the DisplayPort 1.4 standard, this cable offers blazing-fast data transfer speeds of up to 32.4Gbps. With such impressive bandwidth, it enables you to enjoy stunning video resolutions up to 8K at a smooth 60Hz refresh rate. Experience exceptional clarity and lifelike visuals that bring your content to life in breathtaking detail.It's important to note that this cable is unidirectional, specifically designed to connect DisplayPort sources to HDMI displays. It will not function in the opposite direction, meaning it won't connect an HDMI‑equipped computer or video source to a DisplayPort display. Make sure to check your device's specifications before making a connection.The cable's 10ft length provides ample reach to accommodate various setup configurations, ensuring flexibility and convenience. The DisplayPort connector features a standard mechanical latch, ensuring a secure connection between the cable and the panel connector. This latch mechanism helps prevent accidental disconnections, ensuring a stable and uninterrupted signal transmission.In addition to its impressive performance, this cable boasts a range of features that further enhance its appeal. It supports resolutions up to 8K at 60Hz, allowing you to indulge in the latest high‑resolution content with exceptional clarity. Additionally, it can handle 4K resolutions at a staggering 120Hz, enabling smooth and fluid motion for fast‑paced gaming or action‑packed videos.Furthermore, this cable is backwards compatible with older DisplayPort standards, making it a versatile solution for various devices and setups. Whether you have a cutting‑edge DisplayPort 1.4 source or an older generation device, this cable ensures compatibility and seamless connectivity.Rest assured, Monoprice stands behind the quality of this product with their Lifetime Warranty. They are committed to providing customers with reliable and durable cables, ensuring your peace of mind and long‑term satisfaction.With the Monoprice DisplayPort 1.4 to 8K HDMI Cable, 8K 60Hz, you can elevate your viewing experience to new heights.
